pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with softened edge gradients due to image blur. Patch area is relatively smaller on the neck and increases in spatial extent toward the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological graph of light-colored pathways with discernible tri-point junction nodes. Pixel thickness is variable, thinning between closely adjacent flank patches and widening at intersections.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated contour along the neck mane, appearing as a short, uniform vertical protrusion against the background.
